name: GM Rewards™ Mastercard®

welcome_offer.description: Earn 30,000 bonus points after spending $1,000 in the first 90 days of account opening.
notes: Official Barclays page 2026-10-19 (90 days stored as 3 months). estimated_value keeps the record's prior 1 cent/point assumption; Barclays does not state a point value.

earning_rates.notes: 7x points per $1 on eligible GM purchases with the card; GM Rewards members can earn up to 3x more through GM Rewards (up to 10x total).
3x points per $1 on all other purchases, including groceries, gas, restaurants and travel.

other_benefits.name: Intro APR on GM purchases
other_benefits.description: 0% intro APR for 9 billing cycles on qualifying GM purchases over $499 made within 30 days of account opening; 0% promotional APR for 6 billing cycles on qualifying GM purchases over $499 after that; then 22.49%–32.49% variable APR.

other_benefits.name: Complimentary FICO® Credit Score
other_benefits.description: Online access to your FICO® Credit Score.

sources.notes: Official Barclays GM Rewards Mastercard page (2026-10-19): issued by Barclays Bank Delaware; 30,000 points after $1,000 in 90 days; 7x eligible GM purchases (up to 10x with GM Rewards member bonus); 3x all other purchases; $0 annual fee; intro APR on GM purchases.
Official Barclays terms (2026-10-19): Annual Fee $0; Foreign Transaction 3% of each transaction in U.S. dollars.

notes: Co-branded GM card issued by Barclays (formerly Goldman Sachs/Marcus). 7x on eligible GM purchases (up to 10x with the GM Rewards member bonus) and 3x on everything else; points redeem toward GM vehicles, accessories, service and GM Financial payments. 3% foreign transaction fee.
